keys.description: View and edit available shortcuts and input actions
keys.future: Shortcut configuration in {location} was created by a newer version. Upgrade Harness and try again.
keys.invalid: Shortcut configuration in {location} is damaged. Back up and repair this configuration, then {reload}.
keys.macos-web-help: Use Command+/, Command+,, Command+Backslash, Control+Backquote, Command+Option+key, or Command+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
keys.modifier-required: Include Command, Ctrl, or Alt in the combination.
keys.native-failed: Could not protect desktop key recording. Exit recording and try again.
keys.not-ready: Shortcuts are not ready. Please try again.
keys.read: Could not read {location}. Check access permissions, then {reload}.
keys.record-help: Release the keys to save. Tab moves between actions; Esc cancels.
keys.reserved: This combination is reserved for system or text editing actions.
keys.reset-description: Restore the default shortcuts for this platform. All modified or removed shortcuts will be restored. Other platforms are unaffected.
keys.reset-failed: Could not restore defaults. Your shortcuts are unchanged. Please retry.
keys.review: I have reviewed the latest configuration
keys.stale: Shortcut configuration or available commands changed. Review the latest bindings before saving.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.too-many-keys: Hold at most two non-modifier keys. Release the keys to try again.
keys.unsupported-browser: This browser does not support this combination yet.
keys.using-accepted: The last successfully read bindings remain active.
keys.web-help: Browser combinations: Mod+/, Mod+Shift+,, Mod+Shift+.. Mod is Command on Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.
keys.windows-web-help: Use Ctrl+/, Ctrl+,, Ctrl+Alt+key, or Ctrl+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
keys.write-failed: Could not save. Your previous shortcuts and current draft are preserved. Please retry.

zh.description: 查看和编辑当前可用的快捷键和输入操作
zh.future: {location} 的快捷键配置由更新版本创建。请升级 Harness 后重试。
zh.invalid: {location} 的快捷键配置内容损坏。请先备份并修复该配置，然后{reload}。
zh.macos-web-help: 可设置 Command+/、Command+,、Command+反斜杠、Control+反引号、Command+Option+按键或 Command+Shift+按键。也支持三个或四个不同修饰键的组合。浏览器或系统占用的组合可能无法送达页面。
zh.modifier-required: 请同时按下 Command、Ctrl 或 Alt 修饰键。
zh.native-failed: 无法启用桌面录键保护，请关闭后重试。
zh.not-ready: 快捷键尚未准备好，请稍后重试。
zh.read: 无法读取 {location}。请检查访问权限后{reload}。
zh.record-help: 松开组合键即保存。Tab 切换操作，Esc 退出录键。
zh.reserved: 此组合由系统或文本编辑操作保留。
zh.reset-description: 将恢复当前平台的默认快捷键。你修改或移除的快捷键都会恢复，其他平台不受影响。
zh.reset-failed: 恢复默认失败。原快捷键已保留，请重试。
zh.stale: 快捷键配置或可用命令已更新。请核对最新键位后再保存。
zh.title: 快捷键
zh.too-many-keys: 最多同时按下两个非修饰键。请松开后重试。
zh.unsupported-browser: 此浏览器暂不支持该组合。
zh.using-accepted: 当前继续使用上次读取成功的键位。
zh.web-document: 当前网站本地存储中的 dsh.keybindings.v1
zh.web-help: 浏览器可用组合：Mod+/、Mod+Shift+,、Mod+Shift+.。Mod 在 Mac 上为 Command，其他系统为 Ctrl。
zh.windows-web-help: 可设置 Ctrl+/、Ctrl+,、Ctrl+Alt+按键或 Ctrl+Shift+按键。也支持三个或四个不同修饰键的组合。浏览器或系统占用的组合可能无法送达页面。
zh.write-failed: 保存失败。原快捷键和当前草稿已保留，请重试。
